title: Avocado Night Cream Ingredients: What Each One Does and What to Avoid
ex: What's in a typical avocado night cream, what avocado, aloe vera, niacinamide and kojic acid do, how to read an INCI list, and red flags to avoid.
rt: Avocado Night Cream Ingredients Explained | Mirc Glow
rd: Avocado night cream ingredients explained: avocado, aloe vera, niacinamide, kojic acid and the base, how to read an INCI list, and red flags to avoid.
quick: Most avocado night creams combine avocado oil and aloe vera, often with niacinamide and kojic acid, in a base of water, emollients, humectants and preservatives. Read the first five to seven INCI names, check where fragrance sits, and avoid creams with no full ingredient list or batch number.
facts: Ingredients are listed from most to least; below about 1% the order can vary.
Kojic acid is typically used at around 1 to 2% and needs daily sunscreen.
Any cream containing water needs a preservative.
Unlabelled creams promising fast colour change may hide mercury or steroids.
